title: sambucus racemosa subsp. sieboldiana
intro: Sambucus racemosa subsp. sieboldiana, commonly known as Korean elder or Siebold's elderberry, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the family Adoxaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that help to boost the immune system and alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Korean elder include its ability to stimulate lymphatic drainage, reduce swelling and pain, and exhibit antiviral and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular natural remedy for respiratory issues and fever relief. The bioactive constituents of Korean elder include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
